metadata.title: Does the problem of the Nile have a solution?
metadata.abstract: The problem of the Nile has been stated by R. Fisher in 1936. This problem concerns the fair division of an agricultural land and is the eponymous problem of a general class of problems on measures and similar regions. In 1938, W. Feller has shown that the general problem has no solution. However, we will show that under a natural hypothesis, the original problem of the Nile is solvable with connected plots.
